title: Paper handbook availability and usability
summary: Feedback centers on the missing paper handbook and the difficulty of learning features or controls without it, with a few comments saying the system is still easy to work out.

positive.summary: Positive comments say the in-car system or features are easy and even enjoyable to figure out without focusing on a handbook.

negative.summary: Negative comments explicitly dislike the lack of a paper handbook because printed instructions would be quicker and easier than searching online or in the built-in system.

mixed.summary: The mixed feedback praises little here but says the missing paper handbook makes the built-in information hard to search reliably.

undetermined.summary: Many comments mention missing, delayed, or hard-to-obtain handbooks and say this makes new features or controls harder to understand, but the sample does not always make the overall sentiment explicit.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the overall stance is often implied rather than explicit.
The examples are heavily concentrated in GB-market reviews, with very limited evidence from other countries.
This topic mixes handbook availability, handbook delivery, and ease of figuring out controls, so not every fragment addresses the same issue directly.
